findings.name: future-shift-feature
findings.message: `shift(-1)` pulls a value from 1 row(s) in the future into the current row. If this feeds a feature/X column it leaks lookahead bias. (Heuristic: a legitimate forward-return *label* also uses a negative shift — review whether this column is a target, not a feature.)
findings.fix: Use a non-negative shift for features: `shift(1)` (past) or build the forward value only as a prediction target, never as model input.

findings.name: shuffled-timeseries-split
findings.message: `train_test_split` shuffles by default, scattering future rows into the train set and past rows into test. On time-series data this destroys the temporal boundary and leaks the future into training.
findings.fix: Keep time order: `train_test_split(..., shuffle=False)` or use `TimeSeriesSplit`.

findings.name: backfill-imputation
findings.message: `.bfill()` fills missing values using later (future) observations, copying information backward in time. Any row imputed this way leaks data that was not available at that timestamp.
findings.fix: Use forward fill instead: `.ffill()` / `fillna(method='ffill')` / forward interpolation.
